name: Vertical Split Slider
description: Full-screen split slider where a text panel slides down while an image panel slides up in mirror, driven by previous and next buttons straddling the split line.
contents: Left text panel per slide with eyebrow, title, body line, accent rule and watermark index
Right full-bleed image panel per slide
Previous and next pill buttons on the split line and a slide counter
behavior: Clicking next moves the image strip up and the text strip down by one viewport height with an ease-in-out transition
Slides loop from last to first and back
Accent color of the active slide tints the rule, watermark, counter and buttons
editableByProps: Slide count, titles, text, images and accent colors
Split position, transition speed, panel colors, font and counter visibility

needsCodeEdit.where: ps-nav-btn buttons with borderRadius and width in the nav wrapper

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the vignette over the image edge
needsCodeEdit.where: linear-gradient overlay div inside the right panel map

fixed: Slider is full width and one viewport tall (h-screen), and each slide is sized to the viewport height
Loads the chosen Google Font through a CSS import inside the component
Split stays side by side on small screens, so the text panel is narrow on mobile
